manifest.protocolAmendment: After observing a five-request-per-minute limit, group up to seven separate emails into a shared native evaluation state with one explicit email selector per question; preserve original labels. Add 32 exact adapter cases (02 and 08 for every rubric). Repeats are separate native requests. Report grouped and adapter results separately.

notes: Core labels are fixed before running Jev. No other model grades outputs.
Match >=80%; no_match <=20%; otherwise uncertain. Uncertain counts as incorrect on clear binary cases.
Compare with a deliberately simple keyword substring OR actual sender hint baseline; not a best-possible rules engine.
Four variants share one email request; include separate single-question repeats to measure stability and batch context effects.
Ambiguity and truncation diagnostics excluded from primary binary accuracy.
All content is synthetic. No inbox, database, billing, or queue access.
